column3: “The interior” renders the upper regions; the downward direction of coming is not expressed.
BSB supplies “answered”; the critical text has no verb in their reply, while the Textus Receptus has “said” (εἶπον).
John's active baptizing is recast as a description of his baptism.
“Paul” supplies the subject; reasoning and persuading are combined as “arguing persuasively.”
“Paul,” “his,” and “the synagogue” specify the subject, disciples, and departure point.
“And” replaces or between the cloths; the Greek describes them as taken from his skin.
“Them all” replaces both; the statement about a violent attack expands his prevailing against them.
“Province” specifies Asia; “this Paul” is rendered simply “Paul.”
“The men” supplies the subject; “began” is supplied with shouting.
BSB’s “whole” matches the Textus Receptus (ὅλη); “soon” is supplied.
